name: generate_illustration
description: Generate an educational image or explanatory video with fal and save it locally. For video, describe the learning goal and the causal process: initial state, what changes, and observable result. The app plans three visible steps and displays readable captions. Use simple stable objects and a fixed view, not cinematic scenery. Never request baked-in text, formulas or labels. Videos take up to a few minutes; keep teaching while they render. Returns when started; a later update reports the result. You cannot see the finished clip, so do not claim its motion is scientifically verified.

subject.description: Study topic and what the student should understand, 3–600 characters. Example: Paracrine signaling: a cell releases molecules, they diffuse through extracellular space to a nearby cell, bind matching surface receptors, and trigger a response; no bloodstream.

kind.description: image or video; video is a silent explanation with three captioned steps, and may take a few minutes.
